capabilities: Render wiki entries as collapsible cards
Create filtered lists of spells, feats, items, weapons, backgrounds and lineages
Display class pages, subclasses and selected page sections
Autocomplete block types, entry names and filter directives
Create and refresh homebrew content files
disambiguation: Not a wiki browser or editor; it embeds entries from external D&D wikis as cards and lists in your notes.
extras: Requires network access to configured wiki sources; content is cached in memory only, not saved to disk. Depends on the structure of external wikis, so features may break if those wikis change. Includes a legal notice that it is an unofficial fan project not endorsed by Wizards of the Coast.
motivation: The author created it to make writing DM and player notes easier and to reference DnD rules directly from those notes.
problem: Players and DMs must leave their notes to look up D&D rules on external wikis, with no way to embed entries or filtered collections directly in Obsidian.
summary: Renders D&D wiki entries such as spells, feats, magic items, weapons and classes as reference cards and filtered lists inside notes via code blocks.
